The Police Inspector from Vijayanagar Police Station Bangalore has filed charge sheet against the accused SC No.600/2018 No.1 to 3 in connection with the offences punishable U/s.498A and 306 r/w Section 34 of Indian Penal Code in Crime No.349/2014 of their PS.
2.
The gist of the prosecution case is that, the marriage between the accused No.1 and deceased was solemnized on 20-08-2010.
The couple is having a daughter namely Praneetha.
The deceased resided in matrimonial home at the address given in the cause title where the accused No.2 and 3 also resided in a joint family.
But the accused No.1 at the instigation of co- accused harassed his wife and tortured her mentally and physically and abused her in filthy language.

Further it is alleged that,
the accused persons by sharing common intention have insulted the deceased by saying that, she cannot deliver a baby boy in her whole life as such told her to go and die.
That on 28-08-2014 being fed up with their harassment and instigation the deceased at about 3.30 am hanged herself with a ceiling fan in her bed room and committed suicide.
Thereby it is alleged that, the accused persons have committed the offences mentioned above.
3. Since the charge sheet was submitted against the accused persons before the jurisdictional learned XXIV Addl. CMM Court Bangalore.

12. PW-11 now working as PSI in Shivmogga town police station has deposed that, he worked as PSI of Vijayanagar PS from 2014 till 2016.

That on 20-08-2014 when he was the SHO he received a written complaint from CW-1 as per Ex.P-1 accordingly, he registered case against the accused persons in their PS Crime SC No.600/2018 No.349/2014 and prepared FIR.
He identified signatures on first information at Ex.P-1(b) and FIR Ex.P-16 at Ex.p- 16(A).
He further deposed about preparation of mahazar by visiting the spot in presence of CW-2 and 3 and as per the place shown by CW-1 as per Ex.P-2 identified his signature as per Ex.P-2(b).

He also deposed that, at that time he seized the ligature material a saree as per MO-1, seized a death note produced by the accused No.1 at the time of preparing Ex.P-2 and sent the dead body to Victoria hospital mortuary for PM and inquest mahazar.

PW-11 in his further examination in chief on 15-03-2025 has identified the seized death note at EX.P- 17, requisition given to the Tahsildar Bengaluru north for preparation of inquest mahazar at Ex.P-18 and signature at Ex.P-18(a), identified the ligature material a saree at MO-1 and the report given by his staff at Ex.P-19 and signature at Ex.p-19(a).
He deposed regarding handing over of case file to CW-24 for further investigation.
the Police Inspector (PI) has deposed that, he worked as PI in Vijayanagar PS from 2013 till May 2015 and received the case filed on 29-08- 2014 from CW-23 and carried forward the investigation.

On that day he received the Post Mortem report from Victoria hospital as per Ex.P-14 and received viscera of deceased from the doctor of said hospital on 06-09-2014 and included the same in PF No.194/2014.
Thereafter, SC No.600/2018 on 08-09-2014 he send the viscera to the FSL for examination and on the same day handed over the case file to CW-25 for further investigation.
15. CW-25 has deposed as PW-13 and narrated about his period as Police Inspector in Vijaynagar PS from 11-05-2015 till 04-08-2016.

After receiving the case file from CW-24 on 11-05-2014 he received the FSL report on 24-06-2015 identified the same as per Ex.p-15 and obtained the final opinion of the doctor about the cause of death of the deceased Smt. Anitha on 01-07- 2015.
Thereafter, he instructed CW-16 to record the statements of CW-3 to CW-13 accordingly CW-16 handed over the statements of CW-3 to CW-13 to him on 08-09- 2015.

Thereafter, on 03-03-2016 he issued notice to CW- 1 to produce any proof of said incident against the accused and again issued second notice to CW-1 on 31- 05-2016 to produce any proof against the accused and then handed over the case file to CW-26 for further investigation.
16. CW-26/PW-14 deposed to the effect that, he worked as Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP)
of Malleshwaram division.
Earlier he worked as PI in Vijayanagar PS from August 2016 till October 2016 and received case file from CW-25.

sentences.text: As noted above all the private witnesses the relatives and parents as well as the brothers of the deceased Smt. Anitha completely turned hostile to the prosecution case and they deposed nothing against the accused persons so as to connect the guilt as per the prosecution case.
The witnesses who have supported the prosecution case are four police officials as mentioned above.

Of course, the learned defense counsel has cross examined them as they have deposed only to the statutory formalities performed during the investigation after registration of the case post the incident on 20-08- 2014.
Of course, the police officials have denied all the leading questions put to them by the learned defense counsel.
But the evidence of IO and police officials would have been relevant if there is corroboration from independent witnesses such as PW-1 his wife their children and other witnesses.
But all of them turned hostile and clearly deposed that, the accused No.1 and deceased lived together in matrimonial home happily and they are blessed with a daughter.
They have further deposed that, they do not know the cause of death of deceased Smt. Anitha.
They also do not know why she committed suicide on 20-08-2014 while living with her husband and in laws at matrimonial home.

Even though the prosecution has relied on so many documents but the contents of documents such as first information, mahazar, further statements and statements of witnesses are not proved in accordance with law.
More particularly the guilt of the accused No.1 and 3 is not proved as per prosecution case for the offences PUS 498-A and 306 R/w Section 34 of IPC.
It is well settled law that, mere marking of documents do not dispense with their proof.
It is the duty of the prosecution to prove the contents of each document since it has failed to discharge its burden of proof.

Though the prosecution has produced the ligature material MO-1 but there is no evidence to accept its contention that, because of harassment and abetment by the accused persons the deceased committed suicide by using MO-1.

19 . Thus for the discussion made above I am of the opinion that, the prosecution has failed to prove the guilt of the accused No.1 and 3 for the offences PUS 498-A and 306 R/w Section 34 of IPC beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answered the above point No.1 and 2 in negative.
20. Point No.3:-In the result
I proceed to pass the following;

ORDER Acting U/S 235(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 and 3 is hereby acquitted from the SC No.600/2018 charges leveled against them for the offences punishable U/s.498A and 306 r/w Section 34 of Indian Penal Code.
The Bail bonds and surety bond of the accused No.1 and 3 stands canceled.
MO1 being worthless ordered to destroy after appeal period is over.
